name: Teamster
who: a broad, ruddy human male wagon driver of about fifty with a grey-stubbled jaw and a battered grey-brown felt hat, wearing a faded saffron work shirt with rolled sleeves, a worn brown leather apron-vest with belt pouches, dark grey work trousers, and sturdy dusty boots
stow: He has no whip in his hands: the coiled leather whip hangs flat from his belt or is left out of the picture. Both hands are empty and open.
